observations: Photo 0 shows a metal gearbox/reducer unit with a circular output flange/face and multiple cooling fins on the body.
There is a visible brand/watermark text on the image: 'STEVE INDUSTRIAL' (likely from the seller’s page), but no readable model/plate on the reducer itself.
No label plate, serial number, gear ratio marking, or wiring/mounting details are clearly readable in the photo.

claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gearbox/reducer-style metal unit with an output flange and finned body consistent with a speed reducer.

risks.risk: Exact type/gear ratio and mounting interface are unknown; price depends heavily on ratio, shaft size, and flange pattern.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate/label showing brand, model, gear ratio, input/output shaft sizes, and mounting/flange details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used motor speed reducer with unknown ratio and unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not match your motor/gearbox coupling).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be worn, noisy, leaking, or damaged internally).
risks.proof: A short video of it running under load (or at least a spin test) plus photos of any oil leaks/gearbox seals.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/overhaul).

risks.risk: Input/output direction (rotation), backlash, and bearing wear are unknown.
risks.proof: Video showing shaft rotation direction and a measurement/description of backlash (or a technician’s test report).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown backlash/bearing condition (worst-case: higher backlash).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (coupling, mounting bolts, oil, vent plug) could affect usability.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included in the sale laid out, and a photo of the oil fill/level/vent plug area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as reducer only, with no guarantee of included accessories/oil.

proof_requests: Clear nameplate/label photo (brand, model, gear ratio, serial number, input/output specs).
Close-up of input and output shaft/flange faces with dimensions (or a ruler/measurements in-frame).
Video of it running (or at minimum a spin test) showing smooth rotation and no abnormal noise.
Photos of seals/any leakage points and the oil fill/level area.
response.reason: The photo confirms it is a gearbox/reducer, but the key pricing drivers (model/ratio, shaft/flange compatibility, and working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the single image.
